preservedResponsibilities: XLSX open and download reach the native Calc workbook through the existing shell and dialogs. Worksheet relationships, shared strings, sparse cells and local/editable shared formulas are exercised.
The filter reads the related extended Application and establishes source producer rounding and Normal-font metric units before opening worksheets.
The shipped workbook import uses native ZipStorage input on the browser-admitted archive and releases the root after the filter completes.
Creates and releases the workbook shared-string owner and releases unfinished inline strings during parser failure.
Loads the relationship-owned theme before styles and shared strings so the actual workbook graphic helper can resolve the theme.
Installs the original reference-device space metric before XF finalization.
Applies the original XLSX line-break policy before importing cells or formulas.
omittedResponsibilities: Styles, merged ranges, rich cell formatting, and formula conventions beyond the supported Calc compiler remain open.
